import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
# find column index of '0-15'
for c in range(1, ws.max_column+1):
    if ws.cell(row=5, column=c).value == '0-15':
        col = c
        break
print('0-15 at column', col)
# Insert column B (col 2) from col 9, shifting everything right
ws.insert_cols(2)
# Now '0-15' is at col 10
for r in range(6, 11):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=10).value = ws.cell(row=r, column=col).value
# Update Grand Total column L (col 12)
for r in range(6, 11):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=12).value = ws.cell(row=r, column=11).value + ws.cell(row=r, column=10).value
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
